shortDescription: Module for setup of JWTServerProfile Avi RESTful Object

options.name: api_context
options.description: Avi API context that includes current session ID and CSRF Token. This allows user to perform single login and re-use the session.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Avi API version of to use for Avi API and objects.

options.name: avi_api_patch_op
options.description: Patch operation to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_api_update_method
options.description: Default method for object update is HTTP PUT. Setting to patch will override that behavior to use HTTP PATCH.

options.name: avi_credentials
options.description: Avi Credentials dictionary which can be used in lieu of enumerating Avi Controller login details.

options.name: avi_deactivate_session_cache_as_fact
options.displayName: Avi Deactivate Session Cache As Fact
options.description: It disables avi session information to be cached as a fact.

options.name: avi_patch_path
options.description: Patch path to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_patch_value
options.description: Patch value to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: configpb_attributes
options.description: Protobuf versioning for config pbs. Field introduced in 21.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: controller
options.description: IP address or hostname of the controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_CONTROLLER).

options.name: controller_internal_auth
options.description: Jwt auth configuration for profile_type controller_internal_auth. Field introduced in 20.1.6. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: is_federated
options.description: This field describes the objects replication scope. If the field is set to false, then the object is visible within the controller-cluster. If the field is set to true, then the object is replicated across the federation. Field introduced in 20.1.6. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: issuer
options.description: Uniquely identifiable name of the token issuer, only allowed with profile_type client_auth. Field introduced in 20.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: jwks_keys
options.description: Jwks key set used for validating the jwt, only allowed with profile_type client_auth. Field introduced in 20.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: jwt_profile_type
options.description: Type of jwt server profile which defines the usage type. Enum options - CLIENT_AUTH, CONTROLLER_INTERNAL_AUTH. Field introduced in 20.1.6. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as CLIENT_AUTH.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the jwt profile. Field introduced in 20.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of Avi user in Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_PASSWORD).

options.name: protected_resource_config
options.description: Oauth 2.0 protected resource metadata configuration (rfc 9728). Only applicable when jwt_profile_type is client_auth. Field introduced in 32.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: state
options.description: The state that should be applied on the entity.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tenant_ref
options.description: Uuid of the tenant. It is a reference to an object of type tenant. Field introduced in 20.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: tenant_uuid
options.description: UUID of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: url
options.description: Avi controller URL of the object.

options.name: username
options.description: Username used for accessing Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_USERNAME).

options.name: uuid
options.description: Uuid of the jwtprofile. Field introduced in 20.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.
